combinations.name: Hone on Pale-Iron Stone
combinations.text: You draw the pale-iron stone steadily along the cutlass until it gleams like fresh frost.

combinations.name: Coat Blade with Cinder-Oil
combinations.text: Volatile amber oil clings to your blade, smoking gently in the damp air.

combinations.name: Varnish with Weeping Amber
combinations.text: Translucent amber varnish dries into a singing edge that weakens tormented spirits.

combinations.name: Infuse Salve with Distilled Memory
combinations.text: The distilled memory blends smoothly into bittersage, yielding an extraordinarily potent salve.

combinations.name: Rub Weapon with Threshold Salt
combinations.text: Bitter frontier salt cakes along the steel, stinging unnatural flesh on contact.

combinations.name: Concentrate Bellwright Cordial
combinations.text: Warm weeping amber transforms ordinary bittersage balm into a restorative monastic cordial.

combinations.name: Distill Frontier Memory Elixir
combinations.text: Your alembic condenses the mixture into a luminous Mnemonic Elixir.

combinations.name: Inlay Cutlass with Tempered Kiln-Glass
combinations.text: You heat-set razor splinters of Tempered Kiln-Glass along the cutlass spine until it gleams with volcanic fire.

combinations.name: Fit Mnemonic Prism-Shard into Tallow Lamp
combinations.text: You seat the Mnemonic Prism-Shard into the brass bezel; its pale flame splits into crisp, fog-piercing beams.

combinations.name: Waterproof Oilskin with Cinder-Pitch Resin
combinations.text: You brush warm Cinder-Pitch Resin across the seams of your oilskin until it cures into tough, spark-proof plates.

combinations.name: Infuse Salve with Muted Bell-Alloy Dust
combinations.text: Fine bronze filings swirl into the tallow salve with a faint hum, creating Bell-Dust Resonant Balm.

combinations.name: Calibrate Caliper Kit with Brass Mainsprings
combinations.text: You re-tension the brass escapements into a pocket Calibrated Masterwork Caliper.
